versions.changelog:
Initial release of CoinMarketCap Agent for Teneo Protocol

- Provides real-time and historical cryptocurrency market data via CoinMarketCap API.
- Supports features like top cryptocurrencies, real-time quotes, trending analysis, gainers & losers, and performance metrics.
- Designed for both individual users (trading, portfolio tracking) and AI agents (monetization, direct Web3 payments).
- Compatible with Base, Peaq, and Avalanche networks using USDC.
- SDK and agent setup resources included for quick integration.
